title: AWS Infrastructure Engineer
description:
* 3\+ years AWS public cloud experience, preferably in enterprise or financial services environments.
* Experience with AWS technologies including backup and restore, disaster recovery, networking, security groups, network ACLs, troubleshooting, operational logging, storage, compute, and access control.
* Experience with AWS network design including VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect/VPN connectivity, firewalls, security groups, and cloud security constructs.
* Demonstrated experience supporting production AWS deployments and operationalized cloud projects.
* Demonstrated experience with AWS automation and coding technologies including AWS CLI, Terraform, Python, SDKs, and CloudFormation where applicable.
* Experience with Terraform deployments using GitLab, GitHub, or comparable enterprise CI/CD and SDLC tools.
* Experience working with security, operations, engineering, platform, and application teams to deliver complete AWS solutions.
* 3\+ years of experience in enterprise software development lifecycle management.
* 3\+ years of experience in software development, build/release management, and change/incident management.
* 2\+ years of systems administration experience.
* Experience creating and maintaining operational runbooks.
* Participation in Agile/Scrum best practices and methodology.
* Achieved one public cloud Associate\-level certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator \- Associate, or equivalent.


 The AWS Cloud Engineer Junior is responsible for operational support, maintenance, automation, and continuous improvement of the enterprise AWS platform. This role helps ensure the health and stability of cloud services through proactive monitoring, Terraform\-based infrastructure management, AWS platform administration, ServiceNow\-based change/release practices, and delivery of cloud infrastructure solutions that enable business and application teams to operate securely and efficiently.
   

  

* Cloud engineering and operations: via automation and other means, implement platform\-related AWS resources including certificates, keys, storage, compute, network resources, IAM/access controls, and operational logging.
* Infrastructure design and deployment: support private and public cloud patterns, networking, connectivity, storage, virtualization, and access control for enterprise AWS environments.
* AWS networking and hybrid connectivity: support VPC, subnet, routing, firewall, Direct Connect/VPN, Transit Gateway, and hybrid connectivity patterns that integrate AWS with existing customer networks.
* Infrastructure as Code and scripting: use Terraform, Python, AWS CLI, SDKs, and enterprise CI/CD tools to automate repeatable platform capabilities and support applications across the DevOps landscape.
* Performance metrics: monitor, establish, and report key performance indicators that promote success factors for the cloud platform and broader software portfolio.
* Risk, audit, and compliance: manage audit requirements, remediate findings, communicate risks, and support compliance across AWS platform services.
* Disaster recovery: implement, support, and test disaster recovery plans for AWS platform services and DevOps tools.
* Change/release management: use ITIL practices and tools such as ServiceNow to improve operational discipline, change control, release quality, and service efficiency.
* Customer enablement: partner with business, application, security, operations, engineering, and architecture teams to deliver secure, resilient, compliant, and cost\-effective AWS solutions.
* Deep knowledge and experience in software support or development.
* Banking or financial services experience.
* Intermediate understanding of industry, cloud, and AWS concepts and services such as XaaS, IAM, IaaS, serverless, disaster recovery, DevOps, server, storage, and networking.
* Ability to be flexible, adapt to changing priorities, and work under pressure with a calm demeanor.
* Self\-starter who demonstrates initiative and can work independently with limited supervision.
* Effective collaboration skills across organizational disciplines and strong verbal, written, presentation, and technical documentation skills.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Professional or AWS specialty certification preferred.

title: Technology Solution Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands\-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.
   

  

 At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.
   

  

 The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Consulting and Design**
* Engage business functions and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and the problem behind the request.
* Facilitate requirement and design workshops, and translate outcomes into clear technical solution designs.
* Produce options analyses with honest trade\-offs across cost, risk, delivery time, supportability, and strategic fit.
* Author solution designs, architecture decision records, interface definitions, and non\-functional requirements.


**Cross\-Platform Solution Delivery**
* Design and build solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, integration, APIs, automation, containers, and web hosting.
* Provision and configure platform services using Terraform, Ansible, and the approved Infrastructure as Code toolchain.
* Develop supporting automation and tooling in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or another appropriate language.
* Lead technical delivery of solutions involving multiple platforms and multiple contributing teams.


**Service Transition and Operational Ownership**
* Ensure solutions meet operational readiness criteria before production release, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, backup, and recovery.
* Instrument solutions for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, or Observe.
* Own investigation and resolution of complex issues, root\-cause analysis, and preventive corrective actions.


**Security, Compliance, and Risk**
* Design and build to enterprise security standards, applying identity and access patterns based on Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, and least privilege.
* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud\-native key services.
* Identify and articulate technical risk, technical debt, and exceptions, with practical remediation proposals.


**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**
* Write clean, tested, peer\-reviewed code and configuration, managed in version control with trunk\-based practices.
* Review the work of other engineers and raise the standard of design and implementation across the team.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate design, development, testing, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.


**Collaboration and Ways of Working**
* Work within an agile team with a shared backlog, defined customers, and service\-level objectives.
* Act as a credible technical partner to business stakeholders, explaining trade\-offs in plain language.
* Coordinate across platform, cloud, integration, web, security, architecture, and operations teams.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review, and structured feedback.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Demonstrated capability in solution engineering, platform engineering, or technical delivery
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud, with practical exposure to a second.
* Proven ability to own a solution end to end, from requirements through design, build, and operational handover.
* Practical Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and configuration management with Ansible.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or Java.
* Working knowledge across several of: containers and Kubernetes, integration and APIs, web hosting, networking, and identity.
* Demonstrated ability to run workshops and engage business stakeholders directly.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including presenting designs to technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred**
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical workstreams.
* Experience with OpenShift, Backstage or another developer portal, and GitOps tooling.
* Experience with integration or API platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Solace, or Kong.
* Experience with web and application server technologies such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx.
* Experience delivering within a validated, GxP, or otherwise regulated environment, including awareness of data\-protection obligations such as GDPR.
* Certifications such as AWS or Azure professional or expert level, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, ITIL, or an agile qualification.
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.


**Core Competencies**
* Consultative mindset with genuine interest in the business problem
* Strong technical judgement and architectural awareness
* Breadth across technologies combined with useful depth in several
* Clear communication and stakeholder credibility
* Bias toward reuse, standardisation, and simplification
* Ownership and accountability from design through to operation
* Willingness to mentor and raise the standard around them


**Measures of Success**
* Solutions delivered to agreed scope, quality, cost, and timeline
* Increased reuse of approved patterns and platform capabilities, and reduced bespoke build
* Reduced defects, rework, and post\-implementation incidents
* Improved availability and supportability of delivered solutions
* Stakeholder satisfaction and repeat demand from business functions
* Reduced security findings and audit exceptions in delivered solutions
* Demonstrable growth in the engineers mentored

title: IT& Data D&A architect
description:
Expertise expected – Strong data \& analytics architecture expertise with hands\-on credibility on modern cloud platforms (e.g. Azure: ADF, Databricks, ADLS), lakehouse and distributed data processing – Mastery of ingestion/sharing patterns, data modeling and non\-functional requirements (security, scalability, resilience) – Ability to reason across a product perimeter and to arbitrate complex, high\-impact architecture decisions Leadership positioning – Proven experience steering external architects and deciding autonomously within standards – Excellent communication, stakeholder management and servant\-leadership skills
   

  

 Coverage, staffing \& vendor management – Assign architects (mostly external) to products/squads based on demand, in a transversal (multi\-product) mode — without dedicating an architect full\-time to a single squad – Steer vendors: sourcing, scoping, deliverable quality, ramp\-up/ramp\-down and cost control – Anticipate architecture needs together with Product Owners and the Chapter Lead People leadership \& capability building – Onboard, coach and upskill external architects; ensure continuity and knowledge transfer towards internal staff – Monitor vendor performance across the perimeter (quality, timeliness, compliance) Architecture governance (the “what”) – Accountable for solution architecture within guardrails, domain modeling and boundaries, integration patterns, solution security models and non\-functional requirements – Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs); chair the Solution Design Forum (SDF) as final decisionmaker (engineering input is consultative); escalate only strategic architecture decisions Standards adoption – Ensure solutions apply chapter standards, patterns and guardrails, and govern architectural exceptions Double\-hatting (small perimeter) – Contribute directly as a Solution Architect (designs, ADRs), with cross\-review to preserve the separation between producing and validating architecture decisions
   

  

 A D\&A Architecture Chapter Manager is the leader accountable, across a product perimeter, for architect coverage (mostly external), their steering, and the governance of the “what” of data solutions — owning the ADRs and chairing the Solution Design Forum — while applying (not defining) chapter standards. On a small perimeter, the role may double\-hat as a D\&A Solution Architect, with cross\-review, until the perimeter grows beyond the defined threshold.

title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:** 
 R\&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Cloud Operations \& Infrastructure
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Work Mode** 
 : Hybrid work arrangement
   

  

***At AVEVA, we’re all about limitless possibilities. Are you?***
 As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations \& Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud\-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud\-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met.
   

  

 As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud\-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable.
   

  

 The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions.
* Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions.
* Continually develop and improve DevOps processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting.
* Provide timely and effective response to incidents to minimize the impact on our customers and keep colleagues updated as required.
* Oversee relevant Cloud deployments to ensure successful implementation, track and report progress, resolve or escalate release issues.
* Proactively manage cloud environments to minimize service impacting issues, including infrastructure as code, certificates, storage, health status, backup status etc.
* Ensure new services meet required operational readiness standards before being accepted into operations.
* Ensure on\-going compliance to security practices and policies.
* Provide subject matter expertise to business stakeholders as required.
* Maintain clear and accurate operational documentation.
* Stay current on security industry trends, tools and best practices.


**Essential Requirements**
 The following list applies to Azure and/or AWS Platforms.
   

  

* Overall 7\+ years of experience in Software Development with exposure to working on Cloud environments (AWS and/or Azure)
* Strong programming skills, e.g. C\#, .NET Core or Java.
* Knowledge of PowerShell or Node JS or Python scripting.
* Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API, REST, microservices, serverless architecture.
* Knowledge of Cloud Authentication protocols such as OAuth, Identity Servers, OpenID Connect and SAML etc…
* Knowledge of Azure administration, Azure APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIO Management, Service Bus, Event Grids, Storage Accounts and Key Vaults and tools. Or, equivalent AWS experience.
* Knowledge and experience of operational support, software development and deployment methodologies and principles.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Attention to detail, diligent and tenacious.
* Excellent analysis and dissemination skills.
* High degree of personal motivation and ability to self\-manage.
* Maintains and develops relevant industry and technology knowledge.


**Desired Skills And Competencies**
* Certifications in Azure and/or AWS.
* Hands\-on experience working within an Information Security accredited framework e.g. ISO27001, 27017/18\.
* Experience working in Agile software development such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


**R\&D at AVEVA**
 Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
   

  

 Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/
   

  

**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**Role: Cloud Engineer** 




**OCI Platform and Infrastructure Automation** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 We are building our managed services cloud platform as code, starting with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). As a Cloud Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the automation that deploys and runs it: the network hub, shared services, customer connectivity, customer landing zones, and workloads up to and including servers, along with automated backup and disaster recovery. You will also provide Tier 2 support for customer environments already in production. Everything is delivered through infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipelines, with manual steps treated as defects to be automated away.
 



 The focus is cloud platform engineering and automation. Deep expertise in Oracle applications or databases is not required.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Platform and Landing Zone Automation
 


* Build and maintain OpenTofu modules for the managed services platform: network hub, shared services, and centralized security and logging.
* Automate customer landing zone deployments following OCI best practices (such as the OCI CIS Landing Zone): compartments, IAM policies, tagging, budgets, and guardrails.
* Automate customer connectivity into the platform: DRG, FastConnect, IPSec VPN, routing, and DNS.



  





 Security by Default
 


* Build security controls into every deployment: least\-privilege IAM, network segmentation, security lists and NSGs, Vault and key management, Cloud Guard, and Security Zones.
* Implement policy\-as\-code checks in pipelines so non\-compliant infrastructure is caught before it is deployed.



  





 Workload and Server Automation
 


* Automate deployment of compute and servers end to end: images, instance configuration, block and file storage, load balancers, and OS bootstrap (cloud\-init or similar).
* Automate post\-deployment configuration, patching, and agent installation for Linux and Windows servers with Ansible, run from the same pipelines as OpenTofu.



  





 Backup and Disaster Recovery Automation
 


* Automate backup policies and cross\-region replication for customer workloads.
* Build and test automated DR plans (such as OCI Full Stack DR), including regular, repeatable DR testing.



  





 Customer Environment Support
 


* Provide Tier 2 support for running customer environments: troubleshoot incidents, fulfill service requests, and execute changes following change management processes.
* Bring existing customer environments in line with platform standards, automating fixes wherever possible.
* Escalate complex issues to the Cloud Architect with clear findings and next steps.



  





 Pipelines and Engineering Practice
 


* Deliver all changes through GitHub pull requests and CI/CD pipelines, with code review, automated validation, and versioned modules.
* Write Python automation using the OCI SDK and REST APIs, including event\-driven automation using OCI Events, Functions, and Notifications.
* Write and maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles, and module documentation for the platform and customer environments you build and support, so Tier 1 engineers can operate them without escalating.
* Work second shift with overlap for handoffs to the US team, and join the on\-call rotation after onboarding.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* 4\+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2\+ years hands\-on in a major public cloud (OCI, Azure, or AWS).
* Terraform or OpenTofu: writing reusable modules, managing remote state, and deploying through Git\-based workflows. OpenTofu experience preferred; Terraform experience transfers directly.
* Ansible for configuration management: writing playbooks and roles for Linux and Windows (or strong experience with a comparable tool such as Chef, Puppet, or PowerShell DSC).
* Python automation: writing production\-quality scripts and tools using cloud SDKs and REST APIs, including event\-driven automation.
* CI/CD pipelines and GitHub: repositories, pull request workflow, and GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Core cloud services in at least one major cloud: identity and access management, virtual networking, compute, block and object storage, load balancing, and key management.
* Cloud landing zone concepts and best practices: account or tenancy structure, identity, networking, guardrails, and tagging.
* Cloud networking: hub\-spoke designs, VPN and private connectivity, routing, and DNS.
* Solid, hands\-on Linux and Windows Server administration: installation and configuration, patching, storage and file systems, networking, services, user and access management, Active Directory basics, and OS\-level troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting production environments: incident troubleshooting, service requests, and change execution.
* Lifelong learner: self\-driven to research, study documentation and training videos, and figure out unfamiliar technologies on the fly.
* Sound judgment in handling customer data securely and working within compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001\.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable documenting work and collaborating with US\-based team members.



  





**Preferred Skills and Experience** 



* OCI hands\-on experience (strongly preferred). Candidates with strong Azure or AWS backgrounds who are ready to ramp on OCI are encouraged to apply.
* OCI CIS Landing Zone or other landing zone frameworks (Azure Landing Zones, AWS Control Tower).
* Backup and DR automation, including OCI Full Stack DR or similar tools.
* Image and bootstrap tooling such as Packer or cloud\-init.
* Policy\-as\-code tools such as OPA, Checkov, or tfsec.
* Hands\-on experience across more than one public cloud.
* Additional scripting and configuration languages beyond Python, such as PowerShell, Bash, YAML, and JSON.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Managed\-services or MSP experience.
* Certifications: OCI Architect Associate or Professional, OCI Networking Professional, AZ\-104, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, or equivalent.

 As a Database Engineer for the Data Engineering team, you will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing the reliability of our data infrastructure. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Database SRE specialists to ensure highly optimized query layouts, correct database configuration and schemas translate seamlessly into platform automation and IaC frameworks.


**About You**
 We get excited about candidates, like you, because...
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in database operations, or a related role with a focus on data platforms, data stores, data operations.
* Deep experience in AWS RDS, Aurora and NoSQL is a must.

description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, design, develop, and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions for bioprocessing, industrial automation, instrumentation, and process applications.
* Develop reusable software components, backend services, REST APIs, integration layers, data pipelines, libraries, and reference architectures for use across multiple products and programs.
* Integrate software applications with equipment, instruments, PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES, sensors, actuators, and enterprise/manufacturing systems using industrial communication technologies.
* Design solutions for acquisition, processing, storage, visualization, and analysis of equipment, sensor, process, operational, and time\-series data.
* Drive software engineering best practices including object\-oriented design, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, DevOps, deployment, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure software solutions address cybersecurity, data integrity, validation, software quality, reliability, and regulatory requirements for connected and regulated systems.
* Identify and implement practical AI/ML, Generative AI, and advanced analytics opportunities for process monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive maintenance, troubleshooting, engineering productivity, knowledge retrieval, and decision support.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture guidance, design reviews, technology evaluation, mentoring, troubleshooting, and technical decision\-making.
* Lead solutions from architecture and proof\-of\-concept through productization, testing, deployment, and lifecycle support while driving reuse, standardization, automation, and engineering productivity


**Required Qualifications**
* 9–14 years of relevant experience in software engineering, industrial/process automation, electronics or electrical engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong hands\-on development experience in one or more languages such as C\#, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, object\-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, networking, APIs, data structures, system integration, and scalable application design.
* Experience developing backend services, REST APIs, data pipelines, and applications using relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of industrial/process automation, process control, instrumentation, sensors, actuators, control loops, process variables, and data acquisition.
* Working knowledge of PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, historians, MES and industrial protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or MQTT.
* Experience with automated testing, source control, CI/CD, build automation, deployment, and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong architecture, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business and product requirements into secure and scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI, including anomaly detection, predictive analytics, LLMs, RAG, intelligent assistants, AI governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience in bioprocessing, life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, laboratory/instrumentation products, or process industries is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of GxP, validation, data integrity, PAT, APC, soft sensors, digital twins, or model\-based approaches is an advantage.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
**Role: Cloud Architect** 




**Cloud Operations and Automation** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 This is the senior\-most cloud technical role on the team and the direct counterpart to our US\-based Principal Cloud Architect. You will lead the cloud team technically, help build 24x7 cloud operations, and drive an automation\-first approach to how we build, migrate, and run customer environments, primarily in OCI with a growing Azure footprint. The role is hands\-on: you will write automation, execute complex migrations, and own Tier 3 escalations, while mentoring engineers and advising leadership on how the team should grow.
 



 This is a technical leadership role first. People management experience is a plus but not required; we will help you grow into it. The focus is cloud platform engineering: infrastructure, networking, security, and automation. Deep expertise in Oracle applications or databases is not required.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Technical Leadership and 24x7 Operations
 


* Serve as technical lead for the cloud team and primary counterpart to the Principal Cloud Architect.
* Help design and stand up 24x7 support coverage: shift model, escalation paths, on\-call, and handoffs with the US team.
* Assess team skills and gaps, recommend roles and levels needed, and take part in interviewing and hiring.
* Mentor Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, including early\-career hires, and set standards for code, design, and change review.
* Act as final escalation point for complex incidents; lead root cause analysis and write customer\-ready RCAs.
* Work a local day or second shift with overlap for handoffs to the US team, and participate in an escalation on\-call rotation for critical incidents.
* Drive and maintain the team's runbook and knowledge base program, ensuring the engineers closest to the work document it for Tier 1 and Tier 2 use.



 Automation First
 


* Build and maintain reusable automation using OpenTofu for infrastructure and Ansible for configuration management, with Bicep where Azure\-native deployment requires it.
* Write Python automation to replace manual build, migration, and operational tasks.
* Build and run CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Enterprise for deploying and updating customer infrastructure.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools effectively and within company data\-handling policy.



 Cloud Migrations
 


* Lead execution of customer migrations from data center and private cloud environments into OCI: replication, configuration, testing, cutover, and post\-migration support.
* Execute from documented runbooks, improve them, and convert repeatable steps into automation.
* Plan and troubleshoot migration networking: FastConnect, IPSec VPN, DRG, BGP routing, and DNS.



 Platform Standardization
 


* Move existing OCI customers onto the standard shared services and network model, and extend the same patterns to Azure.
* Build and maintain landing zone, networking, and security patterns: OCI VCN/DRG and IAM/compartments; Azure VNet, hub\-spoke, Virtual WAN, and Entra ID/RBAC; Vault/Key Vault; Cloud Guard and Defender for Cloud; policy\-as\-code guardrails.



 Operations and Reliability
 


* Build and tune monitoring, alerting, and logging (OCI Monitoring and Logging, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics).
* Execute disaster recovery, backup, and patching for customer workloads, and automate them where possible.
* Enforce tagging, policy, and cost standards; identify rightsizing and other cost optimizations.
* Report status, risks, and recommendations clearly in writing to the Principal Architect and delivery leadership and join customer technical calls when needed.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* 8\+ years in infrastructure engineering, including 4\+ years hands\-on in public cloud.
* Broad hands\-on experience running production workloads in at least one major public cloud (OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Terraform or OpenTofu: reusable modules, remote state management, and Git\-based workflows.
* Ansible for configuration management: designing playbooks and roles and integrating them with infrastructure\-as\-code pipelines (or strong experience with a comparable tool such as Chef, Puppet, or PowerShell DSC).
* Python automation: writing production\-quality scripts and tools using cloud SDKs (OCI, Azure, AWS) and REST APIs, including event\-driven automation triggered by webhooks, cloud events, or serverless functions.
* CI/CD pipelines and GitHub: repositories, pull request workflow, and GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Comfortable working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Cloud networking: virtual networks, hub\-spoke designs, VPN and private connectivity, routing, and DNS.
* Cloud security fundamentals: IAM, network segmentation, key management, and policy guardrails.
* Tier 3 troubleshooting and root cause analysis in a 24x7 managed\-services or MSP environment.
* Technical leadership: setting technical direction, reviewing the work of other engineers, and mentoring.
* Strong written and spoken English; comfortable working directly with US customers and leadership; produces clear runbooks and documentation.
* Lifelong learner: self\-driven to research, study documentation and training videos, and figure out unfamiliar technologies on the fly across widely varied customer environments.
* Sound judgment in handling customer data securely and working within compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001\.



  





**Preferred Skills and Experience** 



* OCI hands\-on production experience (strongly preferred). Candidates with strong AWS or Azure backgrounds who are ready to ramp on OCI are encouraged to apply.
* Azure and/or AWS hands\-on production experience.
* Workload migrations into public cloud: replication, cutover, and validation.
* Additional scripting and configuration languages beyond Python, such as PowerShell, Bash, YAML, and JSON.
* Monitoring and observability tooling (OCI Monitoring, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, or similar).
* Disaster recovery and backup tooling (OCI Full Stack DR, Azure Site Recovery, or similar).
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Experience building or scaling a 24x7 or follow\-the\-sun operations team.
* People management experience.
* Certifications: OCI Architect Professional, AZ\-104/AZ\-305, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent.

 **Amazon Connect**

title: Sr. Project Construction Manager , AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD)
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Sr. Project Manager is a strategically significant role on the Data Center Construction team dedicated to leading projects for construction of Data centers. You will lead the Electricals Substation and transmission Project and construction management for our projects in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Our Data Center Construction team owns and drives the construction life cycle from pre\-construction, through procurement, to managing the onsite construction work. The Project manager will be expected to dive deep and know construction management; inspire and think big about the construction management program; and support, related stakeholders within AWS to deliver electrical supply capacity and capability to our customers.

* Manage the project delivery across multiple sites including developing managing and reporting on safety, quality scope, schedule and budget ensuring predictable delivery within the business, cost and schedule expectations.
* Strategic and tactical management of construction capacity delivery within Hyderabad
* Communicate and provide guidance to Finance during the development and execution of capital budgets.
* Work with Energy team of AWS to partner on delivering the electrical supply capability and capacity to the Data centers being constructed.
* Coordinate with various teams supporting the data center development and launch.
* Develop and manage metrics quantifying performance within the region.


 A day in the life
   

  

 AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

 Work/Life Balance

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Principal Engineer - Product Development
description:

+ Lead AI innovation initiatives from concept through production deployment.


* Generative AI Architecture

* Model Development \& Fine\-Tuning
+ Lead adaptation and fine\-tuning of foundation models for healthcare\-specific use cases.
+ Develop domain\-specific AI solutions using enterprise, regulatory, engineering, and clinical knowledge.
+ Establish enterprise standards for model benchmarking, evaluation, validation, and continuous improvement.


* Enterprise AI Platform Leadership
+ Develop reusable AI frameworks, accelerators, and reference implementations.
+ Define enterprise architecture standards for AI deployment, observability, governance, security, and compliance.
+ Drive platform modernization using cloud\-native AI architectures.


* AI Governance \& Responsible AI
+ Ensure AI solutions comply with healthcare regulations and enterprise governance requirements.
+ Champion responsible AI principles including fairness, transparency, explainability, safety, traceability, and human oversight.
+ Establish model monitoring, risk management, and AI audit readiness processes.


* Technical Leadership
+ Serve as the highest\-level technical authority for Generative AI initiatives.
+ Conduct architecture reviews and technical assessments.
+ Mentor engineering and AI teams globally.

**Position Summary**

 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges.  At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Principal Product Architect
description:
**Principal Product Architect – Cybersecurity** 
  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (On\-site)
 **Department:** 
 Product \& Engineering
   





**Experience:** 
 12\+ years, including significant time in cybersecurity product companies
   





**About NopalCyber** 
  





 NopalCyber is an AI\-native cybersecurity company that combines offensive and defensive security through its proprietary Exposure Reduction Platform and AI\-powered Cyber Intelligence Quotient (CIQ) risk\-scoring engine, enabling organizations to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, detect, respond to, and remediate cyber risk across complex enterprise environments.
   





**Role Summary** 
  





 We're looking for a Principal Product Architect to own the technical architecture behind NopalCyber's integrated product portfolio — from our External Attack Surface Management to Internal Attack Surface Management to detection and response platform. This is a hands\-on, high\-influence role for someone who has spent their career inside cybersecurity product companies, understands how attackers and defenders actually operate, and knows how to translate that understanding into scalable, secure, and elegant product architecture. You'll set technical direction across multiple product lines, partner closely with Product Management and Engineering leadership, and mentor architects and senior engineers across the org.
   





**Key Responsibilities** 
  




* Own end\-to\-end architecture for Nopal360 (e.g., MXDR/SOC platform, EASM, IASM GRC tooling), from concept through scale, ensuring designs are secure, resilient, and built for multi\-tenant, high\-volume telemetry environments.
* Translate a deep, current understanding of the threat landscape — adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), emerging attack vectors, and the evolving regulatory environment — into product and platform decisions that keep NopalCyber ahead of the threats it defends against.
* Define architectural standards, patterns, and guardrails (data ingestion pipelines, detection engines, API design, identity and access controls, cloud infrastructure) that scale across the Nopal 360° platform.
* Partner with Product Management to shape roadmap decisions, evaluating technical feasibility, security implications, and build\-vs\-buy tradeoffs for new capabilities.
* Lead architecture reviews and design decisions in collaboration with engineering teams, ensuring consistency across services while leaving room for team\-level autonomy.
* Evaluate and integrate third\-party threat intelligence feeds, detection frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT\&CK), and security tooling into the product architecture.
* Act as a technical authority in conversations with customers, prospects, and partners on product architecture, security posture, and platform capabilities.
* Mentor senior engineers and product architects, raising the technical bar across the organization.
* Stay current on the threat landscape and competitive product landscape, and proactively bring in ideas that keep NopalCyber's products differentiated and effective.



**What You'll Bring** 
  




* 12\+ years of experience in software/security engineering, with a substantial portion spent at cybersecurity product companies (e.g., EDR/XDR, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, CTEM, cloud security platforms).
* A track record of architecting cybersecurity products end\-to\-end — not just consuming security tools, but having built them.
* Strong, current understanding of the threat landscape: attacker TTPs, the MITRE ATT\&CK framework, common attack vectors across network, cloud, identity, and application layers, and how detection and response systems are designed to counter them.
* Proven experience designing distributed, cloud\-native architectures that handle high\-volume, high\-velocity security telemetry (logs, alerts, events) with an emphasis on reliability and low\-latency detection.
* Deep knowledge of security architecture principles: zero trust, defense in depth, secure\-by\-design development, identity and access management, and data protection.
* Hands\-on fluency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern data pipelines, and API\-first design.
* Experience partnering directly with Product Management and executive stakeholders to shape roadmap and make architectural tradeoffs under real business constraints.
* Excellent communication skills — able to explain complex technical and threat concepts clearly to engineers, product managers, customers, and leadership alike.



**Nice to Have** 
  




* Experience architecting SOC platforms, MXDR/managed detection services, or attack surface management tooling specifically.
* Prior experience in an offensive security context (red team, penetration testing, or adversary simulation) that informs how you think about defensive product design.
* Relevant industry certifications (OSCP, CISSP, GCIA, GCTI, or similar).
* Experience building or scaling products at a high\-growth cybersecurity startup.



**What We Offer** 
  




* The chance to shape the core architecture of a cybersecurity platform used to protect real organizations, from the ground up.
* A close\-knit, high\-trust team where architectural decisions have direct, visible impact.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and growth path commensurate with a principal\-level technical role.
* A culture built around NopalCyber's mission: making elite, affordable security accessible to every organization, regardless of size.

 Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly\-Clark, Scott Miracle\-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations.

 **$50M\+ EBITDA**

 , and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs.

 **Vista Equity Partners** 
 and
 **Tiger Global Management** 
 .
 



 With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Innovapptive’s Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product\-facing AI agents purpose\-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer\-specific asset data and SOPs.
 



 This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle: from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer\-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust.
 



  





**What You Own** 



* AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation.
* End\-to\-end agent lifecycle: requirements through architecture, build, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring.
* RAG and knowledge infrastructure: document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding.
* LLM governance: model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive’s AWS VPC — no data to external LLM endpoints.
* Agent quality: evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines.
* Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard.
* Hiring, performance management, and coaching.



  





**You Must Have** 



* 7\+ years in software engineering with 3\+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM\-powered products in enterprise production.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi\-step agentic workflows.
* Strong grasp of RAG architecture: document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re\-ranking, and similarity thresholds.
* Experience with managed inference infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent.
* Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context — not just prototypes or internal tools.
* Familiarity with AI observability: prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent).
* Data\-driven: model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team.
* Strong engineering standards: prompt discipline, eval\-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production\-grade reliability.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data.
* Industrial domain knowledge: EAM, ERP integrations (SAP, Maximo), maintenance workflows, or field operations.
* Multi\-agent orchestration patterns: tool calling, agent\-to\-agent delegation, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Vision models or multimodal AI: image\-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation.
* MLOps and LLMOps: model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines.
* Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads: token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies.
* MongoDB and change stream\-based event architectures.



  





**Tech Stack \& Tools** 



1. **AI / ML\-** 
 AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, LiteLLM, LangGraph, Milvus (vector DB), AWS Neptune (knowledge graph), Langfuse
2. **Backend\-** 
 Node.js / TypeScript, Python, MongoDB
3. **Infrastructure\-** 
 AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD
4. **Observability\-** 
 Langfuse, Sentry, CloudWatch
5. **Tools\-** 
 GitLab, Jira, SonarQube



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




  





 Reports to VP PE\&A. Path to Sr. EM or platform leadership as integration becomes a core horizontal capability.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance.
* A platform to shape the semantic intelligence layer of a category\-defining industrial SaaS company.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws

 You will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to understand data requirements, translate them into scalable engineering solutions, and support the migration of legacy data assets into modern cloud environments such as Azure Databricks.

title: Technical Consultant/Architect - Identity Access Management (IAM), OAuth 2.0, API Gateway Support, Python/Java, L2/L3 Support
description:

* Event Framework: Kafka topics, partitions, producers, consumers, broker connectivity, message delivery and EFS API integrations.
* Portal and Diagnostics: Micro\-frontend concepts, browser developer tools, HAR and console analysis, client\-side routing, caching, feature flags and downstream API integration.

**What You’ll Do**
* Review and act on incidents, service requests and access requests logged by implementation teams and platform users.

* Troubleshoot SSO, OAuth/OIDC, token, session, M2M identity, service\-account and credential\-related failures.
* Investigate RBAC, roles, permissions, entitlements, realm configuration, application subscriptions and access\-propagation issues.
* Diagnose API gateway routing, backend connectivity, API policies, rate limits, CORS and HTTP 401/403/404/429/5xx responses.

* Create and maintain runbooks, known\-error records, troubleshooting procedures and knowledge articles for recurring issues.
* Identify repetitive support work suitable for scripting, workflow automation or self\-service enablement.
* Participate in incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, change reviews and an agreed support or on\-call rotation.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Minimum 5\-10 years of relevant work experience in production application support, integration support, identity support or platform operations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capability in business\-critical production environments.
* Hands\-on understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON, headers, status codes and API authentication.
* Practical knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect or comparable SSO and token\-based authentication patterns.
* Experience troubleshooting roles, permissions, RBAC, entitlements, service identities or tenant/realm\-based access models.
* Experience supporting an API gateway or API management product; Gravitee or comparable platform experience is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Kafka or a comparable enterprise messaging/event\-streaming platform.
* Ability to use browser developer tools, HAR traces, network requests and console logs for client\-side diagnosis.
* Working knowledge of Linux, application logs and basic SQL validation.
* Scripting experience with Bash, Python or PowerShell for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Basic understanding of DNS, TLS/certificates, proxies, firewalls and application connectivity.
* Experience with Jira or a similar service\-management tool and a practical understanding of Incident, Request, Problem, Change and RCA processes.
* Ability to document reproducible steps, technical findings, customer impact, corrective actions and handover details clearly.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across users, engineering, cloud and security teams.
* Willingness to participate in a scheduled support or on\-call rotation and planned out\-of\-hours changes when required.


**Our Values**

description:

This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations—such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines—that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability.
   

  

 The Cloud Engineer works closely with Cloud Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Operations to translate architectural standards into durable platform services. **\#BetterDaysStartNow**
**Principal Cloud Engineer**

This role is responsible for delivering standardized, automated, and reusable cloud foundations—such as account provisioning, identity integration, networking baselines, and deployment pipelines—that enable application teams to move quickly without compromising security, governance, or reliability.

**Observability \& Reliability**

**Security, Governance \& Compliance Enablement**
* Partner with Architecture, Security, and Governance teams to enforce identity, access, tagging, and compliance guardrails across cloud environments.
* Ensure platform services are secure\-by\-default, auditable, and aligned with regulatory and enterprise standards.
* Support policy\-as\-code and guardrail automation where applicable.


**Documentation \& Enablement**
* Contribute to platform blueprints, reference architectures, and technical documentation.
* Publish clear guidance and patterns that enable application teams to consume platform services consistently.
* Share knowledge and best practices across the engineering organization.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS; exposure to Azure and/or GCP strongly preferred.

* Solid understanding of core cloud services including IAM, networking, compute, storage, and monitoring.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Engineer.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and platform standards.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Platform services are reliable, repeatable, and consumed broadly by application teams.
* Cloud environments launch with consistent security, networking, and governance baselines.
* Manual effort decreases as automation and self\-service increase.
* Platform standards are implemented in code, not enforced through meetings.
* Application teams can move faster because the platform “just works.”


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

 At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.
   

  

**About MiniMed**
 We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

title: Azure Workload Automation Engineer

Workload Automation Modernization  Assess, analyze, and migrate legacy batch jobs and enterprise scheduler workloads to Microsoft Azure.  Design and develop cloud\-native workload automation frameworks leveraging Azure services.  Modernize file\-based integrations and batch processing workflows.  Consolidate workload scheduling platforms where appropriate to reduce operational complexity.  Create reusable scheduling, orchestration, and workload automation patterns. 2\. Application Development  Develop and maintain workload automation services and components using: o C\# o .NET 8\+ o PowerShell o Python (preferred)  Build reusable frameworks and components for scheduling, orchestration, monitoring, and file processing.  Implement robust logging, exception handling, retry strategies, and resiliency mechanisms.  Follow software engineering best practices and coding standards. 5\. Monitoring \& Operations  Design and implement enterprise monitoring solutions using Azure\-native monitoring and observability services.  Build operational dashboards, alerts, and reporting capabilities.  Implement: o Failure detection mechanisms o Auto\-remediation processes o SLA monitoring o Escalation workflows  Establish audit trails, workload execution tracking, and operational governance.  Ensure high availability and reliability of workload automation platforms. 6\. DevOps \& Platform Engineering  Automate deployments and infrastructure provisioning: o Azure DevOps o GitHub Actions o Bicep o Terraform  Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.  Automate environment provisioning and configuration management.  Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices. 7\. Security \& Compliance  Implement and manage: o Managed Identities o Azure Key Vault integration o Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) o Private Endpoints o Secure file transfer controls  Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security, governance, audit, and regulatory standards.  Follow Azure Well\-Architected Framework security and operational best practices
