 Join us, and you'll be part of a people\-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a Data Platform Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and observability of the Headless Data Architecture (HDA), built on Databricks and Azure. You will ensure data and AI pipelines run reliably in production across multiple regions and continuously improve the platform through automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cost optimization.
 



 Working at the intersection of DataOps, MLOps, and Platform Engineering, you will also help enable AI capabilities through evaluation, prompt management, guardrails, and AI\-assisted tooling.
 



 This role sits at the foundation of HFG’s ambition to become an AI\-powered Workforce\-as\-a\-Service (WaaS) organization. Your work ensures that everything built on top of the platform — from analytics and data products to AI applications — can run reliably, securely, and at scale.
 



 You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Platform Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and governance stakeholders to continuously improve the platform and enable the organization to make better use of data and AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Operate and maintain the end\-to\-end HDA data and AI platform on Databricks and Azure, covering data ingestion, processing, analytics, AI, and serving layers.
* Manage and evolve Unity Catalog governance, including workspace and meta store configuration, access control, credential management, and regional data\-sharing structures.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across data and ML pipelines, driving structured incident response, root\-cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements.
* Build and maintain data ingestion and integration pipelines, including SnapLogic\-based integrations between VMS, HR systems, and the HDA.
* Implement and operate platform\-wide observability using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring, providing both operational monitoring and strategic platform insights.
* Automate and standardize platform operations using Infrastructure\-as\-Code and Databricks deployment tooling, including compute management, job scheduling, scaling, and cost optimization.
* Contribute to the team’s AI\-accelerated engineering tooling, including the UC4 AI\-powered development workbench and supporting MCP\-based capabilities.
* Manage the AI\-platform lifecycle, including prompt versioning, model evaluation, deployment workflows, and environment promotion.
* Implement and operate AI guardrails and safety mechanisms, including input/output validation, PII protection, toxicity detection, and monitoring of AI quality and reliability.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Cloud Engineers to ensure the data and AI platform is secure, reliable, scalable, and production\-ready.
* Continuously improve platform performance, resilience, automation, and operational efficiency across regions and environments.



  





**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks in production, including cluster and compute management, job orchestration, Unity Catalog administration, Delta Live Tables / Lake flow, and production troubleshooting, workspace administration, compute policy enforcement, Databricks Apps management, and multi\-environment workspace configuration.
* Experience administering a Databricks workspace at an organizational level, including Unity Catalog metastore setup, workspace\-to\-megastore binding, catalog and schema hierarchy design, storage credential and external location management, attribute\-based access control, data lineage propagation, and Delta Sharing configuration for cross\-workspace and cross\-region data sharing.
* Experience managing Databricks compute governance, including cluster policies, instance pool configuration, autoscaling rules, spot and on\-demand compute mix, cost attribution tagging, and budget alerting through Azure Cost Management integration.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for deploying notebooks, jobs, pipelines, and model\-serving endpoints across development, staging, and production environments, including bundle configuration, deployment targets, and integration with CI/CD tooling.
* Experience operating the Mosaic AI platform, including the AI Gateway for LLM call routing and rate limiting, Model Serving endpoint configuration and traffic management, MLflow model registry governance, and Databricks Apps deployment.
* Strong experience with Azure data platform services, including ADLS Gen2, Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), networking, Key Vault, resource management, and cost optimization.
* Experience building and operating data ingestion and integration pipelines using SnapLogic or a similar iPaaS, with a good understanding of REST, JDBC, and file\-based integrations.
* Strong understanding of Delta Lake and data engineering patterns, including ACID transactions, table optimization, streaming ingestion, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and GitOps, using technologies such as Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Experience with CI/CD for data platforms, including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, automated testing, deployment gates, and environment promotion.
* Experience with observability and platform reliability, including OpenTelemetry, Grafana Cloud, dashboards, alerting, and defining meaningful SLOs/SLAs.
* Strong automation skills using Python and/or Scala.
* Experience implementing data quality frameworks, such as Great Expectations or Databricks\-native data quality capabilities, including automated validation and expectation management.
* Experience with AI/ML evaluation and validation, using frameworks such as Mosaic AI Evaluation, RAGAS, or equivalent, including LLM\-as\-Judge approaches and metrics such as faithfulness, relevance, and groundedness.
* Experience managing the AI lifecycle, including prompt versioning, prompt\-to\-model binding, environment promotion, and model evaluation across development, staging, and production.
* Understanding of AI safety and guardrails, including input/output validation, PII protection, toxicity detection, hallucination monitoring, and integration with model\-serving endpoints.
* Experience designing or maintaining governed registries for AI capabilities, including agent skills, tool\-use bindings, and MCP server endpoints, with versioning and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of data platform operations, including incident management, root\-cause analysis, performance optimization, resilience, and cost management.
* Ability to translate data, AI, and platform requirements into reliable, scalable, and operationally maintainable solutions.
* Experience working effectively across Data Engineering, AI/ML, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Engineering teams.

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications

* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end\-to\-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement\-gathering and solution\-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source\-to\-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data\-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**
* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source\-to\-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data\-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub\-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third\-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data\-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity\-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data\-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and drive resolution of data\-processing, integration, identity\-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer\-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross\-sell, up\-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next\-best\-action use cases.


**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**
* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead\-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact\-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand\-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.


**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer\-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data\-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data\-processing, API, identity\-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer\-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.


**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge\-sharing, technical sessions, and hands\-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre\-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.


**Preferred Skills**
* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data\-governance requirements.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale customer\-data solutions with high data volumes and multiple source systems.
* Experience supporting customer\-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.

* Cross\-functional collaboration \- Works effectively with business analysts, software engineers, risk, finance, compliance, and product teams to align on data definitions, integration contracts, and model fitness for purpose.
* Technology vendor evaluation \& negotiation \- Evaluates vendor platforms against enterprise requirements using structured scoring. Leads proof\-of\-concept exercises and negotiates commercial terms for data platform and tooling contracts.
* Mentoring \& technical coaching \- Develops junior and mid\-level team members through pair work, structured feedback, and stretch assignments. Builds team capability and independence rather than individual dependency on key staff.
* Familiar with agile / scrum delivery \- Runs or participates effectively in agile ceremonies. Breaks down complex data modeling and architecture initiatives into sprint\-sized deliverables with clear acceptance criteria and definition of done.
* Architecture governance \& technology standards \- Maintains the enterprise architecture standards register, technology radar, and approved patterns catalog. Manages exceptions process and ensures standards keep pace with platform evolution.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 8 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**
* 5\+ years experience as a Data Architect
* Expertise with data modeling concepts including 3NF, Kimball, Data Vault
* Experience in the Financial Services industry
* Excellent Communication Skills including presenting to large audiences and C\-Suite executive
* Ability to collaborate across technical and business teams
* The candidate must be familiar with Enterprise data architecture frameworks \- Applies TOGAF, Zachman, or DAMA\-DMBOK to design enterprise\-wide data architectures. Produces architecture views (conceptual, logical, physical, operational) aligned to business capability models.
* Experience producing Reference architectures \- Authors reusable reference architectures and blueprints for common patterns (e.g., regulatory reporting, real\-time risk, MDM hub). Ensures consistency across solution teams.
* Architecture documentation \& ADRs \- Produces clear, maintainable architecture documentation including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), sequence diagrams, component diagrams, and system context diagrams.
* Experience with data integration architecture \- Designs scalable integration patterns including batch ETL/ELT, Change Data Capture (CDC), event streaming, and API\-led connectivity. Understands idempotency requirements in financial reconciliation workflows.
* Experience with data mesh \& domain\-driven design \- Applies domain\-driven design (DDD) and data mesh principles — bounded contexts, domain ownership, data\-as\-a\-product — to decompose monolithic data platforms without sacrificing enterprise consistency.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses \- Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks (Lakehouse), Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or AWS Redshift. Understands platform\-specific optimization levers (clustering, partitioning, materialization).
* Experience with data lakehouse architecture \- Designs medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architectures. Understands Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Apache Hudi for ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time\-travel on object storage.
* Familiar with the tools in the modern data stack
* Subject matter expertise with Financial data domains \- Deep knowledge of core FS data domains: general ledger, trade \& position, risk, payments, customer/KYC, and reference data (instruments, counterparties, currencies).
* Familiar with data governance principles \- Champions data ownership, stewardship, and policy enforcement. Familiar with DAMA\-DMBOK, enterprise glossary management, and cross\-domain data standards governance.
* Experience with semantic layer \& data product design \- Designs reusable, business\-aligned semantic layers (metrics layers, logical data products) that decouple business logic from physical storage. Ensures consistent KPI definitions across the enterprise.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please contact us to request accommodation.

 8\+ years’ experience delivering enterprise\-scale solutions on Microsoft platforms (Dynamics 365 / M365 Copilot/ Power Platform / Azure), including integration, security, and deployment in customer environments.

 Certifications and/or experience in Azure Solutions, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot and Power Platform; exposure to Azure AI services and GenAI solution patterns is a strong plus.Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and operational readiness (observability, incident response) strongly preferred—especially for AI systems.

title: Engineer II - Cloud Delivery Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
   

  

 LPL's Delivery team is the Cloud Center of Excellence's internal professional\-services crew — the engineers who parachute in with white\-glove service to get applications to the cloud fast. As Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you'll staff Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events, partner with lean application teams, and build Terraform that operationalizes AWS services and third\-party platforms like Confluent Kafka and Kong. If you like shipping real workloads to the cloud with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As the Engineer 2, Cloud Delivery Engineer, you are a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the Delivery team within LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). Delivery is CCOE's internal professional\-services team: it staffs Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events with white\-glove delivery support, partners with less\-funded application teams to get their workloads onto the AWS cloud, and engineers Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services and third\-party platforms (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong). You also help migrate application workloads into the multi\-account landing zone. LPL is an AWS\-first CCOE: a multi\-account landing zone with 100\+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60\+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You partner with the Platforms and Containers teams, the Support team, and the Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), and you spend the majority of your time hands\-on in Terraform and delivery work across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — leaving the teams you help able to run what you built together.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver white\-glove cloud delivery support during Experience\-Based Acceleration (EBA / SBA) and other acceleration events — embedding with application teams to land workloads on AWS quickly and correctly
* Partner with less\-funded / lean application teams to deliver their applications to the cloud: reference\-architecture guidance, hands\-on Terraform, and pairing that leaves the team able to run what you built together
* Engineer Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions that operationalize AWS services — turning a raw AWS capability into a paved, reusable path consumable through the private Terraform module library
* Operationalize third\-party systems on AWS (for example, Confluent Kafka and Kong) as Terraform\-managed, supportable building blocks with clear runbooks and hand\-off to the Support and Containers teams
* Support migrations of application workloads into the multi\-account landing zone — coordinating cutover, validation, and hand\-off
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self\-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to accelerate delivery: AI\-assisted Terraform authoring and refactoring, reference\-pattern scaffolding, migration discovery and documentation, and MCP\-driven self\-service so the teams you help can keep moving after you rotate off
* Operate as a hands\-on mid\-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application\-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security \& Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering \& Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production AWS in a multi\-account environment with hands\-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well\-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well\-scoped engineering work end\-to\-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow\-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on\-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast\-paced, security\-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands\-on experience delivering application workloads to AWS in a consulting, professional\-services, or platform\-delivery capacity — including Infrastructure\-as\-Code delivery and, ideally, operationalizing a managed AWS service or a third\-party system (e.g., Kafka, Kong, or similar) as reusable IaC


**Core Competencies**
* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high\-quality, well\-tested, code\-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud\-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high\-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description


**Preferences**
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004\)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day\-to\-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

title: Member of Technical Staff 4
description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data \& AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As part of the Data Platform team at ThoughtSpot, you'll build and evolve the core platform powering secure, reliable, and high\-performance connectivity between ThoughtSpot and modern cloud data warehouses. The team owns query execution, connection management, authentication, JDBC integrations, platform observability, semantic services, and AI\-powered platform capabilities.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and develop scalable backend platform services using Java 17/21\+.
* Own query execution, connection lifecycle, authentication, JDBC driver management, and CDW metrics.
* Build integrations with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse and other cloud warehouses.
* Improve reliability, scalability, performance, and observability.
* Develop semantic metadata services and AI\-assisted platform capabilities.
* Leverage LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and MCP integrations to enhance platform intelligence.
* Collaborate with Product, AI, Security, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams.
* Drive engineering excellence through testing, automation, and operational ownership


**What You Bring**
* 4\+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong Java (17/21\+), distributed systems, and backend architecture.
* Deep understanding of SQL, query execution, JDBC, connection pooling, and database internals.
* Experience with OAuth, SAML, OIDC, JWT, Kerberos, or similar authentication technologies.
* Hands\-on AWS/cloud\-native development experience.
* Knowledge of observability (metrics, logging, tracing).
* Exposure to semantic layers, metadata management, LLMs, Agentic AI (LangChain/LangGraph/LlamaIndex), RAG, and vector databases.
* Excellent ownership, debugging, and communication skills.


****In\-Office at ThoughtSpot****
 Spotters are expected to be in office 3\+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem\-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in\-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
   

  

**About ThoughtSpot**
 The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI\-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C\-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large\-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision\-making into a truly data\-driven culture.
   

  

 At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data\-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
   

  

**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**
 Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
   

  

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands\-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry\-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.


 Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
   

  

* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary


 This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
   

  

****AI Mindset for All Spotters****
 At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
   

  

 All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
   

  

****ThoughtSpot for All****
 At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****
 ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives \- this balance\-for\-the\-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world\-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
  Experience with Trino, Spark SQL, DuckDB, Calcite, or similar query engines.
   

  

  Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and platform engineering.
   

  

  Passion for building developer platforms and AI\-native analytics infrastructure.

title: Network Automation & Orchestration Engineer
description:
**About Foundever ™**
 Foundever™ is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 170,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for \+750 of the world’s leading and digital\-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter
   

  

**Summary**
 Foundever is seeking an exceptional Network Automation \& Orchestration Engineer to establish and drive our network automation strategy from inception to maturity. This is a transformational role responsible for architecting, implementing, and operationalizing enterprise\-grade automation and orchestration capabilities across our global network infrastructure.

**Technical Delivery**
* Develop production\-grade automation for network provisioning, configuration management, compliance validation, and remediation
* Build intelligent workflows integrating network automation with ITSM, monitoring, and observability platforms
* Implement network testing and validation frameworks ensuring changes are verified pre\-production
* Create automated documentation systems that maintain accuracy through code\-driven processes
* Design disaster recovery and rollback mechanisms for all automated changes
* Develop telemetry collection and analytics pipelines for network insights and predictive automation


**Collaboration \& Enablement**
* Partner with Network Architecture to embed automation into design standards and reference architectures
* Collaborate with Security to ensure automated compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements
* Work with Cloud and DevOps teams to integrate network automation with broader infrastructure automation initiatives
* Mentor and upskill network engineers on automation principles, scripting, and platform usage

**Operational Excellence**
* Provide Level 3/4 escalation support for complex automation platform and workflow issues
* Establish operational runbooks and playbooks for automation platform management

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 7\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience in enterprise environments
* 3\+ years of demonstrated experience designing and implementing network automation solutions at scale
* Proven track record of greenfield automation platform implementation and organizational adoption


**Additional Skills That Would Be Beneficial**
**Core Automation \& Orchestration:**
* Expert\-level proficiency with Ansible (Tower/AWX experience strongly preferred)
* Advanced skills in Python for network automation (libraries: Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, TextFSM)
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform for network infrastructure provisioning
* Practical knowledge of CI/CD platforms (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with source of truth platforms (NetBox, Nautobot, or similar)


**Network Technologies**
* Deep understanding of enterprise routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, VRFs)
* Strong knowledge of network APIs (REST, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC)


**What We Offer**
* Impactful work. Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI technologies that will be game\-changers for our business.
* Professional growth. Continuous learning and development opportunities in a dynamic, remote work environment.
* Competitive compensation. Attractive salary and benefits package.
* Collaborative environment. A supportive team culture with opportunities for occasional travel for training and industry events.

description:
Role Summary
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Reliability Operations Engineer to own day\-to\-day production operations, service continuity, operational readiness, and restoration excellence for critical production services. This role is responsible for monitoring effectiveness, incident coordination, production change execution, operational governance, runbook maturity, automation adoption, and continuous operational improvement across AWS, hybrid data centers, and customer\-hosted environments.
   

  

 As part of the Global Command Center (GCC), this role partners with SRE, engineering, platform, security, product, support, and business teams to ensure services are observable, supportable, resilient, and operationally mature. The role focuses on operational execution and service reliability outcomes while partnering with engineering on systemic reliability improvements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Service Reliability \& Production Operations
   

  

* Own operational execution for day\-to\-day service health, including monitoring, triage, escalation, restoration coordination, operational risk tracking, and service continuity across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Lead operational readiness reviews for new services, releases, infrastructure changes, and production onboarding; ensure support models, runbooks, dashboards, alerts, escalation paths, rollback procedures, access, and validation checks are ready before handoff.
* Operate and tune monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational observability practices aligned with the Four Golden Signals; partner with SRE and engineering on telemetry and instrumentation standards.
* Track SLO attainment, SLA risk, error budget burn, operational KPIs, recurring incidents, and reliability trends; escalate service risk and recommend operational guardrails when thresholds are breached.
* Monitor service performance, infrastructure utilization, capacity, saturation, and customer\-impacting degradation to proactively identify and escalate operational risk.


 Operational Excellence \& Automation
   

  

* Maintain an operational toil backlog and reduce repetitive manual work through automation, scripting, AI\-assisted operations, self\-healing workflows, AIOps capabilities and process simplification.
* Plan, execute, coordinate, and validate production changes including patching, certificate renewals, software releases, infrastructure updates, and maintenance using standardized change governance, risk assessment, rollback readiness, stakeholder communication, and post\-change verification.
* Investigate and troubleshoot complex production issues across applications, infrastructure, middleware, databases, and platform services; restore service while partnering with SRE/engineering on permanent remediation.
* Develop and improve runbooks, SOPs, escalation frameworks, recovery procedures, production validation checks and knowledge documentation to ensure consistent support execution.
* Identify recurring operational failure patterns and partner with SRE, engineering, platform, and application teams to drive preventive controls and permanent corrective actions.


 Incident Management, Reporting \& GCC Collaboration
   

  

* Act as the operational incident lead during major incidents, managing bridges, stakeholder communications, escalation paths, restoration coordination, event timelines, and post\-incident follow\-up.
* Facilitate blameless post\-incident reviews and own corrective\-action tracking for remediation items, runbook updates, automation opportunities, preventive controls, and operational improvements.
* Own incident, problem, and service reliability trend reporting, operational dashboards, SLA/SLO tracking, error budget burn visibility and leadership reviews.
* Support the GCC operational model by driving globally standardized operational practices, governance, runbook maturity, escalation frameworks, and service management processes.
* Collaborate with globally distributed SRE, engineering, cloud operations, security, support, product, and business teams to align operational priorities with reliability risks and service\-continuity needs.
* Mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing while maintaining a customer\-first mindset focused on service reliability, responsiveness, operational quality, and business continuity.


**Qualifications**
* 3\.5 \- 5 years of hands\-on experience in Production Operations, Service Reliability Operations, Infrastructure Operations, NOC, or related operational engineering roles.
* Proven experience managing production environments with accountability for operational stability, incident response, and service continuity.
* Strong understanding of operational readiness, incident management, production support, operational governance, change management, problem management, and reliability practices.
* Practical experience with observability, monitoring, alert tuning, dashboarding and platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, or similar tools.
* Experience using SLO/SLA metrics, error budget burn, incident trends, and operational KPIs to manage service risk and drive continuous improvement.
* Hands\-on experience supporting AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure platforms, and hybrid environments.
* Strong knowledge of Linux and Windows systems, application hosting platforms, middleware, and relational databases.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Exposure to ITIL, operational governance, globally distributed support, or GCC/shared\-services models is preferred.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills; bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent experience; participation in an on\-call rotation for 24x7 GCC support is required.

title: Data Center HR Partner, AWS Builder Experience Team, BeXT
description:
**Description**
 Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on\-site role where you'll be embedded in the Data Centers you support, serving as the voice of Builders and the strategic HR partner to site leadership. You'll work across a cluster of Data Centers, visiting sites daily to ensure every Builder feels valued, engaged, and supported.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence.
* High Judgement. Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations. Serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Strategic Thinking. Connect sentiment trends and HR data to bigger picture operational goals and translate them into clear recommendations that drive leadership action.
* Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization, from builders to senior site leaders, without direct authority.
* Coaching. Develop site leadership in the flow of work.


 This is a 100% Onsite role and requires the ability to travel to assigned Data Center sites within an operational cluster (estimated 25% travel).
   

  

* Data Center environments are 24/7 operational facilities; flexibility to support off\-shift populations and respond to time\-sensitive people matters is expected.
* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; leadership is demonstrated through influence, mentorship, and cross\-functional partnership.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks \& Gemba walks. Proactively monitor Builder sentiment trends using listening mechanisms. Support Builder queries with discretion and expertise. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Establish relationships with employee representative boards.
   

  

 Strategic Partnership: Partner with Data Center leaders at multiple levels to develop proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Identify root causes using sentiment trends and HR data and provide site\-level recommendations to site leadership. Coordinate cluster\-wide communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.
   

  

 HR Expertise: Apply HR fundamentals to problem\-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations. Resolve complex cases independently, navigating Amazon Policies with high judgment. Conduct workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations. Resolve systemic pay, internal transfer, and hiring defects in partnership with central teams. Build procedural policy/governance standards (e.g., SOPs).
   

  

 Leadership Development: Consult, coach, and develop site leadership through decision\-making with empathy and sound judgment. Identify development opportunities through data and anecdotal feedback from onsite floor walks and observation. Educate leaders on HR operating model standards. Support interviews for site manager and technical manager roles.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with partner teams such as HRBPs and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies across your cluster of Data Centers. Partner with New Hire Experience teams on orientation and onboarding. Manage through ambiguity in a fast\-paced, continuously innovating environment.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll conduct weekly Gemba walks, engaging directly with Builders to understand their experience. You'll leverage Builder sentiment data to advocate for their needs, partnering with site leaders to develop proactive strategies focused on engagement. You'll consult and coach leadership through talent management, performance management, compensation decisions, and employee relations issues—applying empathy and sound judgment. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to align on Builder engagement actions. You'll conduct workplace investigations, manage Builder concerns as the first point of escalation, and own site\-specific people projects that drive impact.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, including experience in HR business partner, HR generalist, or HR site partner roles
* Experience supporting hourly/frontline populations of 100\+ employees in an operations or manufacturing environment
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations including conducting investigations and managing complex, high\-risk ER cases
* Working knowledge of local employment law


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in data center, critical infrastructure, construction, or technology operations environments
* Experience supporting a multi\-site or multi\-cluster scope across a geographic region

title: Architect - Infra
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.

title: Senior Architect
description:
**Job Summary** 

 We are seeking a hands\-on, high\-impact Senior Technical Architect (Platform Backend) to lead the architecture, scaling, and continuous evolution of our core platform infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput transactional systems and cloud\-native architecture. You will be responsible for driving high\-level and low\-level designs (HLD/LLD), establishing engineering guardrails, optimizing complex data pathways, and collaborating directly with product and engineering leaders to ensure absolute reliability, performance, and low latency at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities:System Design \& Architectural Leadership:
 * Own the end\-to\-end High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) for core platform services, asynchronous processing components, and enterprise ERP/bank integration adapters.
* Facilitate a smooth transition from monolithic legacy boundaries into clean, highly cohesive microservices domains without impacting uptime or data integrity.
* Establish architectural governance, lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and review critical pull requests to safeguard code quality, clean architecture principles, and SOLID design patterns.


 Scalability, Performance \& Reliability:
 * Architect multi\-tenant, cloud\-native frameworks capable of handling high\-concurrency and petabyte\-scale financial transactions with strict SLAs.
* Diagnose and eliminate system bottlenecks across distributed transactions, locking models, memory management, and network payloads.
* Oversee zero\-trust security compliance, fault\-tolerance mechanisms, automated failover policies, and disaster recovery readiness.


 Data \& Integration Architecture:
 * Design robust relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non\-relational database schemas, complex indexing strategies, data partitioning models, and archival frameworks.
* Scale event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or similar messaging systems to manage reliable real\-time data streaming and asynchronous decoupling.
* Optimize high\-throughput caching architectures (using Redis) to minimize database overhead for intensive financial computations.


 Engineering Culture \& Execution:
 * Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, driving proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) for emerging technologies, and cultivating an environment of fast, first\-principles execution.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management to scope technical roadmaps, decompose epic requirements into modular milestones, and proactively mitigate technical debt.


 Required Skills
 
 A technically deep engineering/product leader with:
 


* **Experience:** 
 12 \- 16 years of professional software engineering experience, with a minimum of 3 years successfully operating in a Technical Architect or Principal Engineer capacity for enterprise SaaS products.
* **Core Backend Stack:** 
 Expert\-level mastery of Java (Java 17\+), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and enterprise\-grade backend frameworks. A profound understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, multi\-threading, and high\-concurrency programming models.
* **Distributed Systems \& Messaging:** 
 Proven experience in building distributed microservices, RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* **Database \& Storage Expertise:** 
 Advanced proficiency in SQL and NoSQL storage engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis). Hands\-on capability with query execution plans, partitioning, and database tuning under heavy write/read loads.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Infrastructure:** 
 Solid production experience with AWS (or Azure/GCP), containerization technologies (Docker), cluster orchestration (Kubernetes), and enterprise CI/CD deployment pipelines.

**About The Role**

 **Principal Performance \& Scale Engineer**

 This isn't a role about running tests — it's about
 **defining what matters, establishing how we measure it, and driving action when reality diverges from goals** 
 . You'll work backwards from customer outcomes, ensuring every benchmark, every metric, and every analysis exists to inform better engineering choices — not just generate data. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise, cross\-functional influence, and strategic thinking, we'd love to connect.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Define and own the organization\-wide performance engineering strategy — establishing which customer archetypes to benchmark against, which metrics matter, and which trade\-offs engineering teams should make to deliver consistent, production\-representative results.
* Establish performance SLOs and scalability envelopes tied directly to real ECM usage patterns; design infrastructure recommendations based on performance analysis — identifying configuration gaps, resource allocation inefficiencies, and architectural constraints that limit scale.
* Apply machine learning to performance data for anomaly detection, predictive bottleneck identification, and automated root\-cause analysis; surface patterns in telemetry that signal architectural risks or optimization opportunities before customers encounter them.
* Define shared performance frameworks across engineering teams so latency SLOs, throughput targets, and scalability trade\-offs speak one language org\-wide; partner with feature teams during design reviews to surface scalability risks early and validate changes at production scale.
* Work backwards from customer outcomes — ensuring every benchmark, every metric, and every analysis exists to inform better engineering choices rather than simply generate data.
* Coach engineers across the organization on performance profiling, load generation, and building diagnosable systems — raising the performance engineering bar org\-wide through credibility and judgment, not authority.


**Technology Tools**
* Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP \& Azure
* Container \& Orchestration: Kubernetes \& Terraform
* Distributed System Profiling Tools
* ML/AI Performance \& Anomaly Detection Tools
* CI/CD \& Benchmark Automation Pipelines
* Observability \& Telemetry Platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent)


**Role Essentials**
* 10\+ years defining performance strategy at enterprise scale — with a track record of determining what to test and why, not just how to run tests; deep expertise in distributed systems, capacity planning, and architectural bottleneck analysis.
* Proven track record of earning trust from executives, PMs, and customer\-facing teams — your insights consistently inform roadmap and architecture decisions at the highest levels of the organization.
* Hands\-on experience benchmarking multi\-tenant or high\-scale platforms with realistic, production\-representative workloads; demonstrated ability to build reproducible benchmarks at scale and make them stick across engineering teams.
* Mastery across cloud\-native stacks — Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure, Terraform, and distributed system profiling tools — with a systems\-level view of performance as a design signal, not just a metric.
* Applied experience with ML/AI in performance analysis — including anomaly detection, predictive modeling, and intelligent test generation; proven cross\-functional influence in aligning multiple engineering teams on shared performance standards through credibility and judgment.


**What We'd Like to See**
* SRE background with hands\-on SLO definition and operational defense — bridging performance engineering and site reliability practices across engineering organizations.
* Experience maintaining living performance documentation — including baselines, runbooks, and scalability trade\-off explainers — that enable engineering and product teams to make confident, data\-driven decisions.
* Exposure to AI workload benchmarking — including LLM inference performance, GPU utilization, and serving\-system scalability in enterprise AI environments.
* Experience with CI/CD\-integrated benchmark pipelines and automated regression detection — ensuring performance results are actionable and triaged within hours, not days.
* Demonstrated ability to surface patterns in production telemetry that signal architectural risks or optimization opportunities months before customers encounter them — protecting customer experience proactively.
